item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00197","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C13","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 is a highly plausible concrete drafting template. The child reproduces its distinctive three-part sequence: designation under the International Organizations Immunities Act; a disclaimer preserving privileges acquired by treaty or congressional action; and a provision deeming the new designation to include a related predecessor body while superseding that body's earlier designation. C13 and C16 closely match the first two provisions but lack the distinctive inclusion-and-supersession machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate the Pan American Health Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.","parent_excerpt":"I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.","explanation":"Nearly identical opening operative designation, with only the organization reference changed."},{"child_excerpt":"The designation of the Pan American Health Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge In any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which that organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.","parent_excerpt":"The designation of the Organization of American States as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which the Organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the parent's full preservation clause and sequence of concepts."},{"child_excerpt":"The designation of the Pan American Health Organization made by this order shall be deemed to include the designation of the Pan American Sanitary Bureau. The designation of the Pan American Sanitary Bureau made by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of July 11, 1946, is hereby superseded, and that order Is amended accordingly.","parent_excerpt":"The designation of the Organization of American States made by this order shall be deemed to include the designation of the Pan American Union, and the designation of the Pan American Union made by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 19, 1946, is hereby superseded.","explanation":"This is distinctive shared administrative machinery: treating designation of a principal organization as including a related body and superseding that body's prior designation."}]}
